    try:
        s = input()
    except EOFError:
        break
    n = len(s)
    result = s[0]
    i = 1
    flag = 0
    while i < n:
        if flag == 0 and i < n - 2:
            s1 = s[i:i+2]
            if s1 == "at":
                result += '@'
                i += 2
                flag += 1
                continue

            s1 = s[i:i+3]
            if s1 == "dot":
                result += '.'
                i += 3
                continue
        result += s[i]
        i += 1
    print(result)
